17. (1) The President shall appoint one of the appointed
members to be the Chairperson of the EC Board.
(2)  The  Chairperson  may  resign  from  the  office  of  the
Chairperson  by  letter  on  that  behalf  addressed  to  the
President and such resignation shall be effective from the
date on which it is accepted in writing by the President.
(3) The President may for reasons assigned therefor remove
the Chairperson from the office of Chairperson.
(4) Subject to the provisions of subsections (2) and (3)
the term of office of the Chairperson shall be the period of
his term of office as a member of the EC Board.
